note: Pricing as data (architecture.md §8.6, progress.md D103). `models` is USD per million tokens, keyed by model id: the browser's copy of apps/factory/config/pricing.json, held equal to it by pricing.test.ts. Rates confirmed at Gate G, 26 September 2026: the meter matched OpenAI's billing exactly (progress.md session log). `features` is a typical use of each feature as its calls, each naming a role in ai-models.json; one entry may stand for several calls to the same role, their tokens summed, since pricing is linear. Token counts MEASURED by the live smoke on 27 September 2026, on prompt version 4 (progress.md D112): writing feedback is one assess call, the average of two; a generated set is one draft call of five items, the average of three, plus five reviews, each averaged.
